rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an amusing story or something said as a joke rather than seriously.

example.english: The joke they told just now was really funny.
example.traditional: 佢頭先講嗰個笑話真係好好笑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tau4 sin1 gong2 go2 go3 siu3 waa6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 siu3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that you are not being serious or are joking with someone.

example.english: I’m just making a joke; you don’t have to take it so seriously.
example.traditional: 我講笑咋，你唔使咁認真。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 siu3 zaa3 nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 jing6 zan1

rows.note: Use this specifically when you are playfully messing with or teasing the person you are addressing.

example.english: I was just playing a joke on you earlier, so don’t be mad.
example.traditional: 我頭先玩吓你咋，唔好嬲呀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 waan2 haa5 nei5 zaa3 m4 hou2 nau1 aa3

rows.note: Use this for a task, test, or problem that turns out to be very easy.

example.english: The test looked hard, but once I did it, I realized it was a joke.
example.traditional: 呢份卷睇落好難，做落先知原來係小兒科。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 gyun2 tai2 lok6 hou2 naan4 zou6 lok6 sin1 zi1 jyun4 loi4 hai6 siu2 ji4 fo1

rows.note: Use this when the worthless person or thing is being held up as an object of ridicule.

example.english: That company is constantly criticized and has become a joke across the whole city.
example.traditional: 嗰間公司成日畀人鬧，已經成為全城笑柄。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 naau6 ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 cyun4 sing4 siu3 beng3
